console.log(null == undefined);  // true
console.log(null === undefined); // false

parts.title: Symbol type
BigInt type
Type conversion
parts.text:
console.log(Number('42'));    // 42
console.log(Number(true));   // 1
console.log(Number(false));  // 0
console.log(String(42));     // '42'
console.log(Boolean(0));     // false
console.log(Boolean('hi'));  // true

parts.title: Data types mastery
parts.text:
const item = {
  id: 1,
  name: 'Laptop',
  price: 999.99,
  inStock: true,
  tags: ['tech', 'sale'],
  seller: null,
};

console.log(typeof item);           // object
console.log(Array.isArray(item.tags)); // true
console.log(item.tags[0]);          // tech

parts.title: Arithmetic operators
parts.text:
console.log(5 + 3);  // 8
console.log(10 - 4); // 6
console.log(3 * 4);  // 12
console.log(15 / 4); // 3.75
console.log(15 % 4); // 3
console.log(2 ** 8); // 256

parts.title: Comparison operators
parts.text:
console.log(5 == '5');   // true  (loose)
console.log(5 === '5');  // false (strict)
console.log(5 != '5');   // false
console.log(5 !== '5');  // true
console.log(10 > 5);     // true
console.log(10 <= 10);   // true

parts.title: Logical operators
parts.text:
console.log(true && true);   // true
console.log(true && false);  // false
console.log(false || true);  // true
console.log(!true);          // false
console.log(!false);         // true

parts.title: Nullish coalescing
parts.text:
const a = null ?? 'default';     // 'default'
const b = undefined ?? 'fallback'; // 'fallback'
const c = 0 ?? 'zero';             // 0
const d = '' ?? 'empty';           // ''
console.log(a, b, c, d);

parts.title: Optional chaining
parts.text:
const user = { name: 'Alice', address: { city: 'Dhaka' } };
console.log(user?.name);            // Alice
console.log(user?.phone);           // undefined
console.log(user?.address?.city);   // Dhaka
console.log(user?.address?.zip);    // undefined
